notes: בדרך כל הארץ: the בְּ is unrepresented, since the ASV writes going the way with no preposition for its own relation (rule 40), and the of belongs to the rectum כל under rule 19.
היום is rendered this day, so the article takes the demonstrative determiner written in its place under rule 41.
ממנו fuses to thereof under rules 22 and 30, headed on the preposition.
